text:
Booking every Tokyo night by Tokyo Station "because the Shinkansen leaves from there"? On our dates that cost about double Ueno, to save 13 minutes on one morning 👇

It's one of the most common booking mistakes on Tokyo-then-Kyoto trips. It feels safe, but you pay for that safety on every single night, not just the last one.

❌ THE MISTAKE

🏨 Paying Tokyo Station prices for every night. On Mon 14 – Thu 17 Dec 2026, two adults, well-rated rooms within 700 m started around ¥84,000 for three nights.

⏱️ WHAT IT ACTUALLY SAVES

🚄 Tokyo Station to Kyoto by Nozomi: 2 h 15 min.

🚄 Ueno to Kyoto, with one change at Tokyo: 2 h 28 min.

🚄 Shinagawa to Kyoto, on the same Nozomi: 2 h 8 min. That's 7 minutes quicker than Tokyo Station.

✅ THE FIX

1️⃣ Sleep in Ueno for good-value nights: three nights from about ¥41,000 on the same dates.

2️⃣ Or Shinagawa if your days are on the west side. Shibuya is 13 minutes away.

3️⃣ Need a no-change, walk-to-the-platform morning with heavy bags or an early train? Move to Tokyo Station for the last night only, and keep the cheaper base for the rest.

💡 ONE MORE THING

Match your hotel to your airport train too. From Narita, the Skyliner reaches Keisei Ueno in as little as 41 minutes. The Narita Express goes to Tokyo Station and on to Shinagawa.

https://japanbystation.com/narita-three-nights-then-shinkansen
